Modern.brandNameRationale: Anchor: 'qajaq' — the original Inuit spelling of the word kayak, used by the modern Greenland-style paddling community to distinguish traditional skin-on-frame design from recreational rotomold kayaks. Counter to K1 Outfitters (racing-class specific) and Greenland Paddle Works (longer compound). Qajaq Co. is the single-word respectful nod.
Modern.industrySummary: Modern paddle sports has split between recreational rotomold kayaks and a serious traditional-design community building skin-on-frame Greenland qajaqs. The opening is for a brand that names the original spelling and serves both markets respectfully.
Modern.competitorLandscape: Wilderness Systems (wildernesssystems.com) plays the recreational peer. Sterling Kayaks (sterlingkayaks.com) holds the sea-kayak reference. P&H Sea Kayaks (phseakayaks.com) is the touring middle. We sit as a traditional-design modern paddle brand.
Modern.positioningStatement: Qajaq Co. is a modern paddle-sports brand using the original Inuit spelling, serving traditional skin-on-frame and contemporary sea-kayak paddlers.

targetAudience.primary: Sea kayakers and touring paddlers 30-55 building skill in the Greenland-paddle tradition.
behaviors: Take a roll clinic each spring
Build or own a Greenland paddle
Plan a multi-day touring trip annually

dos: Credit the tradition without claiming it
Name the paddle and the roll by their Greenland names

Modern.logoDirection: Wordmark: QAJAQ CO. set in a precise grotesk, two words on one line. Small mark: a single narrow Greenland-paddle silhouette used on the deck label.

typography.primary: GT America for the wordmark and headlines
typography.secondary: GT America Mono for paddle dimensions and trip notes
typography.rationale: One grotesk family plus its mono — the touring-log register.

Luxury.brandNameRationale: Anchor: 'baidarka' — the Aleutian skin-on-frame kayak of the Bering Sea, longer and faster than the Greenland qajaq, used historically for long-distance hunting expeditions. Counter to Fjordline Paddle (Scandinavian-skewing) and North Strait & Co. (less specific). Baidarka anchors the luxury expedition register in a real craft tradition.
Luxury.industrySummary: Luxury paddle-sports is a small expedition-and-charter category — multi-week guided trips along Alaskan, Patagonian, and Norwegian coastlines, with bespoke skin-on-frame craft and one guide per two paddlers.
Luxury.competitorLandscape: Tofino Expeditions (tofinoexpeditions.com) plays the high-end guided peer. Sea Kayak Adventures (seakayakadventures.com) holds the expedition reference. Crystal Cruises (crystalcruises.com) is the broader luxury-travel anchor. We sit as a baidarka-tradition expedition house.
Luxury.positioningStatement: Baidarka Expeditions is a luxury sea-kayak expedition house running multi-week guided trips in the Aleutian baidarka tradition.

targetAudience.primary: Experienced paddlers and luxury-expedition travelers 40-65 booking once-a-year trips with a clear craft pedigree.
behaviors: Book trips eighteen months in advance
Re-book with the same guide annually

dos: Name the guide and the craft on every itinerary
Credit the Aleutian tradition with restraint
donts: Photograph paddlers in extreme weather as the hero shot

Luxury.logoDirection: Wordmark: BAIDARKA EXPEDITIONS set in a refined serif, two lines centered. A hallmark — a single long baidarka silhouette with a paddler — used on the trip dossier cover.

typography.primary: Tiempos Headline for the wordmark and headlines
typography.secondary: Tiempos Text for body and trip dossiers
typography.rationale: A single classical serif family — the expedition-house register.

Minimal.brandNameRationale: Anchor: the hull — the single most important word in boat design, the part that meets the water. Counter to Paddle. (over-punctuated) and Roll (verb-as-noun, harder to register). Hull is the trade noun, single syllable.
Minimal.industrySummary: Minimal paddle-sports brands serve experienced paddlers who want a single boat in their fleet with no decoration. The opening is for a single-word trade-noun brand.
Minimal.competitorLandscape: Sterling Kayaks (sterlingkayaks.com) plays the minimal-design peer. Tahe Outdoors (taheoutdoors.com) holds the touring reference. NDK (seakayakinguk.com) is the heritage-British middle. We sit as the single-word minimal option.
Minimal.positioningStatement: Hull is a minimal paddle-sports brand — one boat line, one paddle, one rate card.

targetAudience.primary: Experienced paddlers 30-55 replacing a touring boat after a decade of use.

dos: Show the boat from the side
Confirm the order in one line

Minimal.logoDirection: Wordmark: HULL set very large in a clean modern sans, four letters, one word. No symbol.

typography.primary: ABC Diatype for the wordmark and headlines
typography.secondary: ABC Diatype Mono for hull dimensions
typography.rationale: Clean Diatype with its mono — the single-boat register.

Corporate.brandNameRationale: Anchor: 'tideway' — the trade word for a tidal channel, used by long-standing British rowing and paddling firms. Counter to Pacific Paddle Group (too geographically narrow) and Strait & Sound Outfitters (longer and less ownable). Tideway Kayak Co. reads as an institutional multi-site outfitter.
Corporate.industrySummary: Corporate paddle-sports operators run multi-site outfitting and lesson businesses across coastal and lake regions, with shared rental fleets, instructor certification programs, and corporate-events bookings.
Corporate.competitorLandscape: REI Co-op Adventures (rei.com/adventures) plays the multi-site peer. Outdoor Adventure River Specialists (oars.com) holds the operator reference. NRS (nrs.com) is the outfitter-supply middle. We sit as a multi-site outfitting operator in the Tideway register.
Corporate.positioningStatement: Tideway Kayak Co. is a regional multi-site paddle-sports outfitter and lesson provider operating across coastal and lake regions.

targetAudience.primary: Regional outdoor-recreation buyers, corporate-events planners, and franchise partners across coastal markets.

dos: Lead with fleet capacity and instructor certifications
Speak to corporate-events and outdoor-recreation buyers
donts: Run consumer extreme-sport marketing at the parent level
Photograph individual paddlers as the hero shot

Corporate.logoDirection: Wordmark: TIDEWAY KAYAK CO. set in an institutional serif, three lines centered. A small mark — a single paddle blade — used on the contract cover.

typography.rationale: A reading serif plus a clean grotesk — the multi-site outfitter register.

Creative.tagline: When the boat is upside down, you get out.
Creative.brandNameRationale: Anchor: 'wet exit' — the kayaker's term for bailing out of a capsized boat, the first skill every beginner learns. Counter to Two Blades, One River (too tagline-shaped) and Bracing Strokes (less universally recognized). The Wet Exit is the insider trade term that becomes a brand name.
Creative.industrySummary: Creative paddle-sports brands lean on insider vocabulary and a teaching ethic. The opening is for a brand that names the most-feared beginner skill plainly and turns it into a welcoming mark.
Creative.competitorLandscape: Aqua-Bound (aquabound.com) plays the paddle-brand peer. NRS (nrs.com) holds the outfitter-supply reference. Werner Paddles (wernerpaddles.com) is the heritage-paddle middle. We sit as an insider-vocabulary creative paddle brand.
Creative.positioningStatement: The Wet Exit is a creative paddle-sports brand and instruction school named for the first skill every kayaker learns.

targetAudience.primary: Beginner and intermediate paddlers 28-50 taking lessons and buying their first serious gear.
behaviors: Sign up for a roll clinic each spring
Buy a paddle before a boat

dos: Write the lesson plan in the instructor's voice
Use the wet-exit drill as the brand's hero image
donts: Photograph experts as the hero shot

Creative.logoDirection: Wordmark: THE WET EXIT set in a punchy serif, two lines. Small mark: a single upturned kayak silhouette with a paddler emerging — the wet-exit illustration — used as the stamp.

typography.rationale: A warm display serif plus a clean grotesk — the lesson-school register.
